ValidationRule.description: Entity type is required when an account is created as Current, whenever its Status changes, or when the Entity type is cleared on a Current account. It no longer fires on every save of a legacy Current account with a blank Entity type (narrowed Sep 2026). The Bypass Account Validation permission (NetSuite refresh user) skips it.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK(TEXT(Entity2__c)), OR( ISCHANGED(Status__c), AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Current"), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Entity2__c)) ) ), NOT($Permission.Bypass_Account_Validation) )
